meta.description: Every pathway after Class 10, Class 12/PU, ITI and Diploma: streams, diploma, ITI trades, defence entries, degrees and professional courses, with eligibility, exams, cost and outcomes.
meta.disclaimer: Curated for EduSelect from official and reputable public sources (compiled 2026-10-04). Fees and private-sector salaries are estimates (isEstimate=true) and must be shown with an 'Estimate' badge. Government pay is from the 7th CPC pay matrix (basic pay, excludes DA/HRA). Exam rules, age limits and fees change every cycle - re-check the official notification before relying on any value.

sources.title: National Testing Agency (JEE Main, NEET-UG, CUET, NCET, NCHM JEE, UGC NET)
Directorate General of Training (ITI trades, NCVT)

costBasis.total: Approximate total programme cost in INR

meta.note: Rows with linkedDataset point to engineeringBranches.json or govtJobs.json for the detailed job roles.

items.name: Science - PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Maths)
items.eligibility: Class 10 pass; many schools/PU colleges set a 60-75% cut-off
nextSteps: JEE Main / JEE Advanced for IITs, NITs, IIITs
State CETs (KCET, MHT CET, EAPCET, WBJEE, KEAM...)

items.name: Science - PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
items.eligibility: Class 10 pass; schools may set a 60-75% cut-off

items.name: Science - PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology)
nextSteps: Keeps both JEE and NEET open

items.name: Vocational stream (NSQF subject in Class 11-12)
keySubjects: Academic core + IT/ITeS, retail, healthcare, automotive, agriculture, tourism etc.

items.name: Diploma in Engineering (Polytechnic)
items.eligibility: Class 10 pass + state polytechnic entrance or merit
nextSteps: Junior Engineer (JE) jobs: SSC JE, RRB JE, state JE
Lateral entry to B.E./B.Tech 2nd year (DCET, ECET, DSE, LET...)

items.name: Paramedical certificate / diploma (lab, X-ray, OT, ECG, GDA)
NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling)
nextSteps: Valid for JEE / NEET / CUET and all degrees
outcomes: Suits athletes, artists and working students

items.name: Performing arts / sports academies (SAI, Khelo India)
Army Agniveer - General Duty
items.eligibility: Class 10 with 45% aggregate and 33% in each subject; age 17.5-21

cost.note: Paid: ₹30,000/month (year 1) rising to ₹40,000 (year 4); in-hand 70% (₹21,000 → ₹28,000); ~₹11.71 lakh Seva Nidhi at exit (tax-free)

nextSteps: Up to 25% retained as regular soldiers
Priority in CAPF / state police after exit

items.name: Sainik Schools / Rashtriya Military Schools
items.eligibility: Entry at Class 6 or 9 via AISSEE
outcomes: Future defence officer (feeder school, not a job)

items.name: Government jobs for 10th pass (SSC MTS, SSC GD, RRB Group D, India Post GDS, police constable)
items.eligibility: Class 10 pass; age limits by exam
nextSteps: See government jobs with minimum qualification Class 10

items.name: B.E. / B.Tech (Engineering)
items.eligibility: Class 12 with PCM; JoSAA needs 75% in Class 12 (65% SC/ST) or top-20 percentile

cost.note: IIT ≈ ₹2L/yr and NIT ≈ ₹1.25L/yr (waivers for SC/ST/PwD and low family income); state government seats ₹10k-1L

items.name: B.Sc (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Electronics, Geology)
BS-MS / Integrated M.Sc (IISER, NISER, CEBS)
keySubjects: Physics, chemistry, biology, maths, research projects

cost.note: ISI pays a stipend; CMI fees differ - check

items.name: BCA / B.Sc Data Science / AI / Cyber Security
Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL)
items.eligibility: Class 12 PCM; age 17+; DGCA Class 1 medical

cost.note: Includes flying hours; type rating extra

items.name: Merchant Navy - DNS / B.Sc Nautical Science / B.Tech Marine Engineering
nextSteps: DG Shipping Certificate of Competency exams

items.name: GP Rating (Merchant Navy crew)
nextSteps: Promotion to officer with sea time + exams

items.name: NDA (National Defence Academy)
items.eligibility: Class 12 (PCM for Navy & Air Force; any stream for Army); age 16.5-19.5; unmarried

cost.note: Free training with stipend; commissioned at Level 10 + Military Service Pay

nextSteps: Commission as Lieutenant / Sub-Lieutenant / Flying Officer

items.name: Army TES / Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry
Agniveer Vayu / Navy SSR / Coast Guard Navik (GD)
items.eligibility: Class 12 (PCM 50% for science trades); age limits apply

items.name: MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine & Surgery)
items.eligibility: Class 12 PCB with English; NEET-UG qualified; age 17+

cost.note: Government seats via MCC (15% AIQ) and state counselling (85%)
